what: Proposed validator CLI initializes quiet logging before validation
scenario_or_breakage: Wrappers source an exported DESIGN_TMPDIR before calling the new verb. logging_util.quiet_init can create a larch-quiet log under that unvalidated directory before validate_design_tmpdir rejects it, so an invalid existing design tmpdir gets written to before the security gate runs.
suggested_fix: Remove logging_util.quiet_init from validate_design_tmpdir_main and print validation failures directly to stderr with _plain_err or print.
